annotation:
There are some variations here.  Various amounts of remastering over the years.  Don't think anything has been edited out but details change as well as speed.  (Done some basic comparison with ear and Audacity)

AcoustID [https://acoustid.org/track/65b922da-6b70-4834-ab22-bc183e332c39|65b922da-6b70-4834-ab22-bc183e332c39] on [https://musicbrainz.org/release/2d55ea34-801a-4b41-8b26-afeafd74c4f8|The Business: The Definitive Singles Collection], [release:8d32b103-6f66-4544-8562-286eca05c9d8|I ♥ 2 Party] long fade

AcoustID [https://acoustid.org/track/6dc160e4-58f3-4006-9607-41d5c36680d0|6dc160e4-58f3-4006-9607-41d5c36680d0] on [https://musicbrainz.org/release/288eed6d-d7df-4f64-8821-48e37ab02ecf|Into the Eighties] less fade but matches audio above.

AcoustID [https://acoustid.org/track/6527cc57-f2f5-49ac-91e5-34bdd1379cbc|6527cc57-f2f5-49ac-91e5-34bdd1379cbc] on [https://musicbrainz.org/release/09ee57d1-ff29-4fd5-9136-ae63a4c0c217|Divine Madness].  Small speed tweak here

Heavily remastered AcoustID [https://acoustid.org/track/ee778a7f-0292-4600-96ce-83b3a8328f90|ee778a7f-0292-4600-96ce-83b3a8328f90] on [https://musicbrainz.org/release/b9b13b9c-ec28-48af-ae05-947983f6755c|Anthems: Alternate 80s].  This has been sped up more as well as being made louder.

title: Hush
annotation:
Attention! There are at least two versions of studio recordings of this song by Deep Purple:

1968 Deep Purple version
    Ritchie Blackmore - guitar
    Rod Evans - lead vocals
    Nick Simper - bass, backing vocals
    Ian Paice - drums
    Jon Lord - organ, backing vocals

1988 Deep Purple version
    Ritchie Blackmore - guitar
    Ian Gillan - vocals, Harmonica
    Roger Glover - bass
    Ian Paice - drums
    Jon Lord - organ, keyboards

See:
